svg.title: Planning and Dispatch Through a Tracker
svg.desc: A UML sequence diagram, read top to bottom, with six lifelines: the Planner, the agent MCP gateway, Jira, the Jira Watcher, the Developer and the Operator. The Planner assigns a ticket in Jira, through the agent MCP gateway. The Jira Watcher reads the change through the agent MCP gateway and publishes it as a ticket.* message, which reaches the Developer. The Developer works the ticket and passes it to the Operator in Jira, through the agent MCP gateway, and the Operator answers there. The Jira Watcher reads that change the same way and brings the answer back to the Developer as a new message. The Planner, the Jira Watcher and the Developer are Agents, the Jira Watcher's proposer a script; each Agent calls its own gateway, and the Jira Watcher publishes on the bus. A note says the tracker's wait is in its own history, and nothing enters the exceptions queue.
